verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents an official web SDK: a JS tag/snippet with a JS reference based on and compatible with Analytics.js. It also claims 100% Segment-API compatibility plus a React integration, and Profile Builder consumes `identify` events. Server-side collection is documented only as a raw HTTP API, not an SDK, and nothing in the evidence shows a mobile SDK. missing for 10: official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android), an official server-side SDK beyond the raw HTTP API, an explicit spec page enumerating track/identify/page calls, independent hands-on corroboration across platforms.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can collect events from web, mobile, and server apps through official SDKs that implement a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page)

citations.quote: The API is based on [Analytics.js](https://getanalytics.io/api/), and is compatible with it.
Jitsu javascript integration is 100% compatible with Segment API. In addition to that we have React integration
You can use HTTP API to send data to Jitsu. This is useful if you want to send data from your backend.
Profile Builder generates profiles based on the `traits` object in `identify` events.
